Name: Jengoa's Scarecrows
Author: J3ngoa
Description:
Hello!
I made a few scarecrow skins just for fun and thought
maybe other people will enjoy them!

So here they are![u]

Installation:[/u]
1. Download and extract the mod into your mods folder
2. Don't forget you need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿ as well for this to work!
3. Get the paint bucket item from Robin's Carpenter Shop
4. Use it on the appropriate items to apply the new textures and enjoy!

The house in one of the screenshots is the wonderful [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28918]Brayflox Farmhouse[/url]
The shirt my farmer is wearing is from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15135]IdaIda's Farmer's Shirts[/url]
And I am using [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1966]Elle's Dirt and Cliff Recolor[/url]

Let me know if there are any stray pixels (my eyesight is quite bad), also let me know if you have any ideas
for additional scarecrows!

And credits to PeacefulEnd for their awesome Alternative Textures framework
